name: Killgore
storyline: Bull returns for revenge fully armed and dangerous to the slaughterhouse for a bloody vengeance, your aim is to destroy anyone that comes in your way. this bull has some kick ass moves so enjoy kicking some butt
summary: Killgore is a fast paced beat-em-up game made in Adobe Flash Player where you take hordes of enemies through the levels located in a animal slaughterhouse, controlling a jacked bull with a gun arsenal. You can punch, shoot and block to make your way into the chaos while you finish everyone with a good chunk of gore.
